verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can upload documents, spreadsheets, photos and videos to get "answers, summaries, and insights about your content" (gemini-docs-25). Deep Research can draw on personal Gmail, Drive and uploaded files (gemini-docs-47), Connected Apps summarize emails (gemini-docs-30), and the Daily Brief proactively surfaces prioritized suggestions (gemini-docs-32). Community reports of strong meeting-recording notes and large-corpus comprehension (gemini-comm-10, gemini-comm-19) partly corroborate this, though they don't clearly refer to the consumer app. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specific to the consumer app's data-insight features, and detailed docs on proactive suggestions beyond the Daily Brief.
